C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 201
Date 27/3/16
Municipal Police.
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPT.
Captain Superintendent's Office.

Shanghai, March 25th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that Huang Hsin's son has left here for
Canton with a large sum of money for the use of the rebels
in that province.
X It is reported that Chen Chi Mei 陳其美 and Han Hwe 韓恢
X will leave Shanghai for Fokien within a few days.
It is reported that the rebels in Frenchtown intend
to issue military notes. It is also reported that the
same gang of rebels are devising means for the kidnapping
and holding to ransom of rich merchants.
It is reported that Chu Tsung 朱正 who was a rebel
General at Woosung during the second Revolution, arrived
here from Japan a few days ago.
A telegram has been received officially notifying
the Arsenal authorities that Yuan Shih Kai has abandoned
the monarchical program.
Six hundred recruits arrived yesterday at Woosung
from Tientsin.
There is a considerable friction between General Lu
and the officer in charge of the forts at Woosung.

Your Obedient Servant,

(签名)

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

(左侧手写批注：
(1)

pages.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记
第 201 号
日期 1916年3月27日
工部局警务处。
刑事调查处。
警司办公室。

上海，1916年3月25日。

先生：
据报，黄兴之子已携带巨款离开此地前往广州，供该省叛乱分子使用。
X 据报，陈其美与韩恢（音译）将于数日内离开上海前往福建。
X
据报，法租界内的叛乱分子意图发行军用票。另据报，同一伙叛乱分子正在策划绑架富商并勒索赎金的手段。
据报，朱正（音译）曾在二次革命期间担任吴淞的叛军将军，于数日前从日本抵达此地。
已收到正式电报，通知兵工厂当局袁世凯已放弃帝制计划。
六百名新兵昨日从天津抵达吴淞。
卢将军与吴淞炮台负责人之间存在严重摩擦。

您顺从的仆人，

(签名)

总探长。

警务处警司。

(左侧手写批注：
(1)
KMP
3月27日)
